title: Characterization of a methane-producing microbial community processing acidic effluent from sugar beet molasses fermentation
description: The object of this study was to obtain and characterize a continuous methanogenic culture that constituted part of a two-stage anaerobic digestion system aimed at hydrogen and methane production.
center: Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics Polish Academy of Sciences
samples: Metagenome sample from activated sludge from a municipal waste treatment plant
explicit urban setting at sample level
